name: Mixed positions and duplicate digits
test:
game = Solution()
assert game.getHint("1807", "7810") == "1A3B"
assert game.getHint("1123", "0111") == "1A1B"

name: All bulls and no matches
test:
game = Solution()
assert game.getHint("0011", "0011") == "4A0B"
assert game.getHint("0000", "1111") == "0A0B"

name: All cows preserve repeated occurrences
test:
game = Solution()
assert game.getHint("1122", "2211") == "0A4B"
assert game.getHint("1234", "4321") == "0A4B"

name: Limit cows by available occurrences after bulls
input: duplicate guesses, matches already consumed by bulls, and unequal digit counts
test:
game = Solution()
assert game.getHint("1122", "0001") == "0A1B"
assert game.getHint("1000", "0001") == "2A2B"
assert game.getHint("1110", "0111") == "2A2B"
assert game.getHint("1122", "1111") == "2A0B"
assert game.getHint("0012", "2200") == "0A3B"

name: Single digits and leading zeros
test:
game = Solution()
assert game.getHint("0", "0") == "1A0B"
assert game.getHint("0", "1") == "0A0B"
assert game.getHint("0123", "3012") == "0A4B"

name: Repeated calls and maximum supported length
test:
game = Solution()
assert game.getHint("0123456789" * 100, "1234567890" * 100) == "0A1000B"
assert game.getHint("7" * 1000, "7" * 1000) == "1000A0B"
assert game.getHint("7" * 1000, "8" * 1000) == "0A0B"
assert game.getHint("12", "21") == "0A2B"
